Post-treatment assessment: Clinical assessment and screen for signs and symptoms, with additional referral as needed
Shunt assessment for ventriculoperitoneal shunts every 6 months
Neurological cognitive and functional impairment assessment
Neuroimaging only if clinically indicated (magnetic resonance imaging if available)
Muscle tone management and transport needs (e.g. wheelchair)
Feeding options, including percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy with or without fundoplication
Endocrine assessment in case of thalamic injury
